FX-TURBTYPE-001.says: Size 4, fractal type turbulent_smooth: rounded creases, softer than turbulent's.

FX-TURBTYPE-002.says: Size 4, fractal type turbulent_sharp: thin, sharp creases.

FX-TURBTYPE-003.says: Size 4, fractal type dynamic: each octave pushed by the clouds so far, the clouds drawn out.

FX-TURBTYPE-004.says: Size 4, fractal type dynamic_progressive: each octave pushed further than the last.

FX-TURBTYPE-005.says: Size 4, fractal type dynamic_twist: each octave pushed in a direction the clouds turn, like smoke.

FX-TURBTYPE-006.says: Size 4, fractal type max: each octave only ever lightening the clouds, light clouds.

FX-TURBTYPE-007.says: Size 4, fractal type smeary: the finer octaves streaked across.

FX-TURBTYPE-008.says: Size 4, fractal type swirly: bands that follow the clouds, like agate.

FX-TURBTYPE-009.says: Size 4, fractal type rocky: flat patches in five greys, like camouflage.

FX-TURBTYPE-010.says: Size 4, fractal type cloudy: soft light puffs on dark.

FX-TURBTYPE-011.says: Size 4, fractal type terrain: light ridges.

FX-TURBTYPE-012.says: Size 4, fractal type subscale: the fine detail only where the coarser clouds are light.

FX-TURBTYPE-013.says: Size 4, fractal type small_bumps: small bumps, starting two octaves finer.

FX-TURBTYPE-014.says: Size 4, fractal type strings: thin light lines where the clouds cross the middle grey.

FX-TURBTYPE-015.says: Size 4, fractal type threads: thin threads at every scale.

FX-TURBTYPE-016.says: Size 4, noise type linear: straight lines between the points, a harder look than smooth.

FX-TURBTYPE-017.says: Size 4, noise type soft_linear: softer at the points than linear.

FX-TURBTYPE-018.says: Size 4, noise type spline: a smooth wave through every point.

FX-TURBTYPE-019.says: Size 4, dynamic_twist on spline, inverted, evolution keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 720 at frame 4, linear: the smoke moves as it evolves.

FX-TURBTYPE-020.says: Size 4, rocky on block, contrast 200: square flat patches.

FX-TURBTYPE-021.says: Size 4, terrain on linear at complexity 20, the most.

FX-TURBTYPE-022.says: Size 4, swirly at complexity 1.9, which counts as 1: sin(3 pi v) of the one octave.

FX-TURBTYPE-023.says: FX-TURBTYPE-006 (max) moved three pixels right: worked in the drawing's own space, so it moves with it.

FX-TURBTYPE-024.says: Fractal type "Turbulent Basic", the name shown and not the word written. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TURBTYPE-025.says: Noise type "soft linear", with a space and not the underscore. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
